item.name: Bedding
item.about: A small, circular pile of moss. Sitting or laying on bedding gives players the Resting status, which provides a 50% buff to their health regeneration.

item.name: Food Storage
item.about: A bowl. You can deposit food you are holding by pressing , where it will then appear in the bowl. Herbivore and carnivore food cannot be mixed, meaning you will need two different food storages if you need to store both types simultaneously. item.name: Hydrated Moss
item.about: A muddy pile of wet moss. Standing on top of it slowly refills your moisture bar.

item.name: Light Source
item.about: A clump of crystals that emit a yellow light.

item.name: Lure
item.about: A floating crystal that periodically spawns NPCs wherever it is placed.

item.name: Pack Banner
item.about: A customizable banner showcasing your pack's emblem. While in range, packmates deal 5% less damage to each other.

item.name: Planter
item.about: A planter that spawns a cherry bush which serves as an herbivore food source, just like the ones that spawn around the map. The cherry bush will always spawn upwards regardless of the planter orientation.

item.name: Shelf
item.about: A storage shelf to place resources on. Building materials placed on it do not despawn.

item.name: Skull Pile
item.about: A large pile of creature skulls that afflicts non-packmates with the Fear ailment, which keeps stacking as long as they remain within range.

item.name: Wall
item.about: A wall that blocks out other players. Members of your pack can pass through. For building purposes they have no collision hitbox.

item.name: Water Storage
item.about: A bowl that fills with clean water. You cannot deposit water yourself, you must wait for rain, snow or any similar weather event that refills water sources. It does not have to be placed in the open, it can refill even if placed under shelter. Caps at 150 water.
